mapper.select: /* mtgInqyDao1020 : 회의 상세 조회 */ SELECT M.MTG_ID , M.MTG_TITLE , M.MTG_CONT , TO_CHAR(M.MTG_SDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MTG_SDT , TO_CHAR(M.MTG_EDT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS MTG_EDT , M.MTG_LOC , C_LOC.CODE_NM AS MTG_LOC_NM , M.REG_IDX , E.ORG_CD , O.ORG_NM , E.EMP_NM , E.RANK_CD , R.RANK_NM FROM MEETING M LEFT OUTER JOIN EMP_INFO E ON M.REG_IDX = E.EMP_IDX LEFT OUTER JOIN ORG O ON O.ORG_CD = E.ORG_CD AND O.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN RANK R ON R.RANK_CD = E.RANK_CD AND R.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT OUTER JOIN CODE C_LOC ON C_LOC.CODE_CD = M.MTG_LOC WHERE M.MTG_ID = #{mtgId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

/* mtgInqyDao2010 : 회의 (캘린더) 조회 */ SELECT '' AS "TITLE" , TO_CHAR(TRUNC(M.MTG_SDT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00' AS "START" , TO_CHAR(TRUNC(M.MTG_SDT), 'YYYY-MM-DD') || ' 00:00:00' AS "END" FROM MEETING M GROUP BY TRUNC(M.MTG_SDT)
mapper.insert: /* mtgProcDao1010 : 회의 등록 처리 */ INSERT INTO MEETING ( MTG_ID , MTG_TITLE , MTG_CONT , MTG_SDT , MTG_EDT , MTG_LOC , REG_IDX , REG_DT , USE_YN , DISP_ORDER , REMARK ) VALUES ( (SELECT 'MTG_' || LPAD(NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(REPLACE(MTG_ID, 'MTG_', ''))), 0) + 1, 4, '0') FROM MEETING) , #{mtgTitle, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{mtgCont, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , TO_DATE(#{mtgDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{mtgStm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , TO_DATE(#{mtgDt, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{mtgEtm, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') , #{mtgLoc, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , #{regIdx, jdbcType=VARCHAR} , SYSDATE , 'Y' , (SELECT NVL(MAX(DISP_ORDER), 0) + 1 FROM MEETING) , NULL )
